ticker: Nvidia Chip Sales Under US Scrutiny
San Francisco Braces For Major Floods
Tata Sons Weighs Public Listing Decision

articles.headline: COP31 Climate Talks Collapse Without Agreement
articles.brief: Global climate negotiations at COP31 collapsed after participating countries failed to reach a consensus regarding fossil fuel phase-outs and crucial climate finance promises, marking the first breakdown of its kind since 2009.

articles.headline: Trump Threatens Fresh Military Strikes On Iran
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump issued a warning threatening fresh military strikes against Iran after the New Year if ongoing negotiations fail, accusing Tehran of stalling diplomatic talks and increasing regional aggression.

articles.headline: US Seeks Answers On Nvidia Chip Sales To China
articles.brief: US officials are pressing for clarifications regarding Nvidia's ongoing semiconductor sales to Chinese entities, as trade authorities intensify scrutiny over technology export controls and clandestine supply chains.

articles.headline: Tata Sons Gears Up For Major Decision
articles.brief: The board of Tata Sons is preparing to decide whether to go public or remain private, navigating internal divisions alongside regulatory nudges from the Reserve Bank of India regarding compulsory listing timelines.

articles.headline: Carlos Alcaraz Wins Historic ATP Finals Match
articles.brief: Tennis star Carlos Alcaraz scripted history by securing a major victory at the ATP Finals against Alexander Zverev, becoming just the fourth player ever to achieve a rare milestone at a remarkably young age.

articles.headline: Bisleri Faces Court Action Over Water Quality
articles.brief: India's food safety regulator has initiated court prosecution against Bisleri International after packaged drinking water samples allegedly failed safety tests, revealing excess levels of specific chemical contaminants.

articles.headline: San Francisco Braces For Historic Flood Threat
articles.brief: San Francisco is preparing for potential historic coastal flooding as unusually high tides and a powerful approaching storm threaten low-lying neighborhoods and roads during the peak Thanksgiving travel season.

articles.headline: Crypto Platforms Ordered To Review Cross-Border Deals
articles.brief: Regulatory authorities have instructed cryptocurrency platforms to thoroughly review their financial products, compliance frameworks, and cross-border transactions to mitigate potential systemic financial risks.

articles.headline: Anthropic Runs Unusual IPO Process Like SpaceX
articles.brief: AI startup Anthropic adopted an unconventional initial public offering process reminiscent of SpaceX, sparking discussions and frustration among institutional Wall Street bankers managing the equity debut.

articles.headline: Pernod Ricard Weighs Major India IPO Plans
articles.brief: Beverage giant Pernod Ricard is actively considering an initial public offering for its Indian operations as the local market rapidly closes in on the United States in terms of global sales volume.

articles.headline: German Army Tests AI Targeting Drones In Lithuania
articles.brief: The German military has commenced tactical field testing of advanced kamikaze drones equipped with artificial intelligence targeting tools at defense installations deployed across Lithuania.

articles.headline: Union Budget Expected To Slash Manufacturing Duties
articles.brief: The upcoming government budget may introduce import duty cuts ranging between one and three percent across numerous manufacturing inputs to strengthen domestic production competitiveness.

articles.headline: Adulterated Alcohol Claims Eleven Lives In Manipur
articles.brief: At least eleven people have died following the consumption of toxic adulterated alcohol in India's northeastern state of Manipur, prompting immediate local administrative investigations and police raids.

articles.headline: Israel Coalition Talks End Without Formal Agreement
articles.brief: Political negotiations between Benjamin Netanyahu's party and opposition factions regarding the formation of a broader governing coalition have concluded without reaching a final cooperative deal.

articles.headline: Microsoft Automation Glitch Delays US Flights
articles.brief: A major technical outage linked to automated aviation systems disrupted holiday schedules, causing more than a thousand flight delays across major US airports including Atlanta and New York.
